book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: APOCALIPSIS I tsictesʌbal Jesucristo tsa' bʌ pʌsbenti Juan

content: Jini x'ixic yic'ot jini colem bʌ ajin
Tsa' tsictiyi ñuc bʌ i yejtal i p'ʌtʌlel Dios ti panchan: juntiquil x'ixic lʌpʌl bʌ i cha'an q'uin. An uw ti' yebal i yoc. C'ʌcʌl ti' jol jump'ejl corona melbil bʌ ti lajchʌmp'ejl (12) ec'.
Cʌntʌbil to i yalobil jini x'ixic. Tsa' caji ti wocol. Tsi' cha'le oñel che' woli ti bajq'uel, come i yorajlelix mi' yilan pañimil i yalobil.
Tsa' tsictiyi yambʌ i yejtal i p'ʌtʌlel ti panchan. Awilan, an colem ajin chʌchʌc bʌ. An wucp'ejl i jol yic'ot lujunts'ijt i xulub. An wucxojt i corona.

I ñej tsi' tujc'a cabʌl ec' ti panchan. Tsi' choco jubel ti lum jujump'ejl ec' loq'uem bʌ ti u'uxp'ejl. Jini ajin tsa' wa'le ti' tojel x'ixic che' woli ti bajq'uel cha'an mi' c'uxben i yalobil che' mi' yilan pañimil.

Tsi' yila pañimil ch'iton bʌ i yalobil mu' bʌ caj i cha'len yumʌl ti pejtelel tejclum tac, chucul i cha'an vara yilal melbil bʌ ti tsucu taq'uin. Tsa' pʌjyi letsel i yalobil ba'an Dios c'ʌlʌl ti' buchlib Dios.
Tsa' puts'i majlel jini x'ixic ti jochol bʌ lum ba' chajpʌbil i yajñib ti Dios cha'an ya'i mi' we'sʌntel jini x'ixic uxc'al i chʌmbajc' (1,260) q'uin.
Ti wi'il tsa' caji guerra ti panchan. Miguel yic'ot i yángelob tsi' cha'leyob guerra ti' contra jini ajin yic'ot i yángelob jini ajin.
Tsa' mʌjli i cha'an Miguel. Ma'anix tsa' chʌn tajle ti panchan i yajñib jini ajin yic'ot i yángelob.

Tsa' chojqui jubel jini colem ajin. Jiñʌch jini oñiyix bʌ lucum, am bʌ cha'chajp i c'aba', xiba yic'ot Satanás. Jiñʌch mu' bʌ i lotin pejtel winicob ti pañimil. Tsa' chojqui jubel ti lum yic'ot pejtelel i yángelob.

Tsa cubi c'am bʌ t'an ti panchan. Tsi' yʌlʌ: Tsa'ix tili i coltʌntel winicob x'ixicob yic'ot i p'ʌtʌlel yic'ot i yumʌntel lac Dios yic'ot i p'ʌtʌlel Cristo. Come tsa'ix chojqui jubel jini mu' bʌ i sub i mul la quermanojob. Mi' sub lac mul ti' tojlel Dios ti q'uiñil ti ac'ʌlel.
Jini hermanojob tsi' mʌlbeyob xiba cha'an ti' ch'ich'el jini Tiñʌme' yic'ot i t'an tsa' bʌ i subeyob. Ma'anic tsi' c'uxbiyob i cuxtʌlel che' bʌbʌq'uen mi' yʌjq'uelob ti chʌmel.

Yom tijicña panchan yic'ot chumulo' bʌ ti panchan. Obol la' bʌ añet bʌ la ti pañimil yic'ot ti colem ñajb, come jini xiba tsa'ix jubi tilel ba' añetla. An cabʌl i mich'ajel come yujil lʌc'ʌlix i yorajlel, che'en.
Jini ajin che' bʌ tsi' q'uele chocbilix jubel ti lum, tsa' caji i yajñesan majlel jini x'ixic tsa' bʌ i yʌc'ʌ ti pañimil ch'iton bʌ i yalobil.

Tsa' aq'uenti jini x'ixic cha'q'uejl i wich' che' bajche' i wich' colem xiye' cha'an mi' puts'tan xiba. Tsi' cha'le wejlel majlel ti jochol bʌ lum ti' yajñib. Ya' tsa' we'sʌnti jump'ejl jab yic'ot cha'p'ejl jab yic'ot ojlil jab.
Jini lucum tsi' beq'ue loq'uel ja' ti' yej che' bajche' colem ja'. Tsi' chocbe majlel ti' pat jini x'ixic cha'an mi' jisan ti but'ja'.
Jini lum tsi' colta jini x'ixic. Jini lum tsi' cawa i yej yilal. Tsi' japʌ jini colem ja' tsa' bʌ bejq'ui loq'uel ti' yej ajin.
Jini ajin cabʌl tsi' mich'le jini x'ixic. Tsa' majli i cha'len guerra ti' contra pejtel i p'olbal x'ixic mu' bʌ i jac'beñob i mandar Dios, mu' bʌ i ñopbeñob i t'an Jesucristo.
